basic_info.description: Fully detached 2 bedroom, 2 bath home in the highly desirable Lake Shore District. The side entry opens onto formal living and dining rooms accentuated with crown moldings and parquet floors. The living room has a large picture window with custom drapes, tray ceiling, decorative fireplace and classic mantel and hearth. The eat-in kitchen has a large window overlooking a landscaped backyard. backyard. The lower level includes a legal rumpus room (possible 3rd bedroom) and bathroom with laundry. The rumpus room opens onto a pergola-covered patio and fenced backyard with lovely mature plants. It also has newer exterior paint. Home reflects pride of ownership.
